points.en: M1 = Currency with public + Demand deposits with banks + Other deposits with RBI
points.hi: M1 = Currency with public + Demand deposits with banks + Other deposits with RBI

points.en: M2 = M1 + Savings deposits with Post Office savings banks
points.hi: M2 = M1 + Savings deposits with Post Office savings banks

points.en: M3 = M1 + Net time deposits with banks (Broad Money)
points.hi: M3 = M1 + Net time deposits with banks (Broad Money)

points.en: M4 = M3 + Total deposits with Post Office savings organizations
points.hi: M4 = M3 + Total deposits with Post Office savings organizations

explanation.en: M1 is most liquid, M4 is least liquid.
explanation.hi: M1 is most liquid, M4 is least liquid.

question.en: Which measure is known as Broad Money?
question.hi: Which measure is known as Broad Money?

answer.en: M3 is known as Broad Money.
answer.hi: M3 is known as Broad Money.

misconception.en: M3 includes all post office deposits.
misconception.hi: M3 includes all post office deposits.

correction.en: M3 includes only bank deposits; M4 includes post office deposits.
correction.hi: M3 includes only bank deposits; M4 includes post office deposits.

en.en: M1 is the most liquid measure.
en.hi: M1 is the most liquid measure.

en.en: Time deposits are not part of M1.
en.hi: Time deposits are not part of M1.

en.en: M3 is the most commonly used measure for policy.
en.hi: M3 is the most commonly used measure for policy.

en.en: Post office savings are excluded from M3.
en.hi: Post office savings are excluded from M3.

en.en: Assuming all deposits are demand deposits.
en.hi: Assuming all deposits are demand deposits.
